scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names server,client --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace client && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build && npm run dev --workspace @restaurant-pos/desktop
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npm run build --workspace @restaurant-pos/desktop
scripts.desktop:start: npm run desktop:build && npm run start --workspace @restaurant-pos/desktop
scripts.test:electron:linux: npm run desktop:build && npm run desktop:ensure-runtime && node scripts/electron-linux-acceptance.mjs
scripts.desktop:linux: npm run desktop:build && npm run package:linux --workspace @restaurant-pos/desktop
scripts.desktop:win: npm run desktop:build && npm run package:win --workspace @restaurant-pos/desktop
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
